restart_confirm_body: Crawling pauses for about {seconds} seconds while Lodestar restarts.
restart_confirm_address_help: You'll be taken there after the restart and asked to confirm it. If you don't, the old address comes back after 5 minutes.
restart_keep_body: Lodestar is now at {url}. If you don't confirm, it goes back to the old address.
restart_page_waiting: Lodestar is restarting. This usually takes about {seconds} seconds.
restart_page_pending: Lodestar is back, but some changes still wait for a restart. A setting may be fixed by an environment variable.
restart_page_timeout: Lodestar hasn't come back after 2 minutes. Check:
restart_page_check_logs: The container's logs, for the reason it stopped.
restart_page_check_healthcheck: Run lodestar healthcheck where Lodestar runs.
restart_page_moving: Lodestar is restarting and will be at {address}.
restart_keep_countdown_sr: It goes back by itself after about 5 minutes if you don't keep it.
restart_keep_announce: Lodestar is now at {url}. Choose Keep this address, or it goes back by itself.
